text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak says in an international press conference with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu: Peace is our top priority and we must overcome the obstacles or else the alternative will be extremely difficult and complicated.
- Mubarak to visit Chicago during his trip to the United States and will meet with top business people there, including heads of Amoco Corp, Motorola and Baker Mackenzie.
- Mubarak and French President Chirac to discuss the Middle East peace process on Friday.

- Netanyahu reaffirms his position that is contrary to peace and stability. Mubarak says after his meeting with the Israeli prime minister: Netanyahu is not implementing his obligations and there will be negative effects on the peace process.
- Mubarak tells Israeli business people that peace is the only way forward for the development and progress of the peoples of this region.
- Egypt will represent the Middle East in the regional energy forum to start in Paris next week.
- In the local council elections: there are less candidates than there are seats.
- Mubarak and U.S. Vice President Al Gore discuss setting up a free trade zone.
